headlines.text: On this day in 2022, the AEW World Tag Team Titles had a new owner by the end of the night as Swerve in our Glory vs. Hobbs & Starks vs. The Young Bucks battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.64 ? a war that left everything in the ring ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. In a chaotic three-way dubbed "Triple or Nothing," a solo Swerve Stomp on Ricky Starks made the Bucks the shortest-reigning champions in AEW tag title history ? just 28 days.
That Saturday in 2019, Kenny Omega vs. CIMA locked horns for the first time on Fight for the Fallen, rated 8.30 ? a genuinely great match.
Back on this day in 2024, Cassidy & O'Reilly announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.36.
